tbesh_html:
Aramaic of kas.di (כַּשְׂדִּים "Chaldea" H3778)
§ Chaldean, of Chaldea "clod-breakers"
1) a group of people usually associated with the area around Babylonia
2) the learned class of priests, magicians, or astronomers

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}
